package.hash_scope: Runtime files excluding Saved* directories and debug PDBs; freeze this package.

historical_log_incident.note: Accidental reuse of historical ground-study output directory overwrote EditorBuild.log. Historical report and frozen snapshots have not been rewritten. New material evidence uses separate natural-ground directory.

visual_review.scope: Selected full-resolution still frames, not a continuous video or full visual acceptance.
visual_review.material_views: All seven editor fixed images reviewed: Murg original/v1/v2, Weesen original/v2, Mols original/v2. V1 grass too dry. V2 restores greener balance, softens rock/grass contours and adds restrained neutral detail. Large blurry photo patches persist.
visual_review.package_views: Both R2 launcher images, selected Weesen/Murg/Mols return/surface/completion frames, both Mols30 return/completion frames, and all three benchmark endframes reviewed. Runtime materials load; return and summary views remain readable.
remaining_visual_issues: Large blurred aerial-photo regions in Weesen and Murg.
Strong stretched far-cliff colours and sparse/unconvincing forest.
Some visibly raised tree contacts in normal Weesen/Murg return views despite conventional far-LOD root fix.
Horizontal waterline/volume bands visible in surface views; no claim of clean continuous waterline transition.
visual_review.underwater: Accepted art preserved in scope; one-sided packaged regression endframe shows rendered rocks/gravel and water haze. No new underwater art iteration.
visual_review.route_limit: Centred automated key-input routes passed. Off-centre rail approach can still block standing pose in regular gameplay; no universal return-route acceptance.

variant_provenance: Final material v2 used in MurgAfter, WeesenAfter, MolsAfter and all packaged candidate tests. MurgV1 used locally frozen Variant1 assets; failed initial SM6 attempt excluded.
module_provenance: All fixed editor comparisons recorded module20b952bc4605b41f6c5dd5c683f79aba8d6a4a54cf903800b20f3af1e6ef00f4. That DLL was replaced before it was separately archived. Final snapshot records R2 module after shore-test lateral steering was added; benchmark implementation and materials unchanged between these builds. R1 package is a rejected regression candidate, not a release.
return_fixture: R1 Mols shore run reached landing with physical swim blend0.734 and failed standing assertion. Samebinary originalmaterialcontrol passed, at different lateral offset. R2 uses normal lateral keys to approach landing centre, anticipates velocity; all collision and standing assertions retained.

rejected_shader_run.reason: Stored original material library lacks PatchNoise helper; actual SM6 compile failed. Corrected to existing Noise helper before valid comparisons.

scope: Above-water material blend/detail change plus previously validated tree root fixes and two-tile terrain pilot. Underwater art accepted; regression only. Grass classification remains an authored colour heuristic.
performance_scope: Short fixed editor pairs and one 60s orbital packaged pair on same binary/containers. Not a statistical speedup, long-session or all-settings guarantee. Underwater run is a one-sided regression.
open_items: Blurred large aerial-photo patches and baked shadows at near shore remain visible.
Forest volume, variety, remaining visibly raised tree contacts, far cliff materials and uninspected terrain boundaries remain open.
Known CPU/GC hitches and underwater technical rest items are not declared resolved.
